_comment: Single source of truth for FTDI's LibFT4222/D2XX download (issue #133). Used by scripts/fetch_ftdi.py (CI), scripts/build_installer.py (installer download), and scripts/check_ftdi_download.py (monitoring). FTDI's DLLs are never committed or bundled; the user's installer downloads them. Update all fields together and re-verify signatures. The top-level url/sha256/files are the amd64 (x64) pin; 'arches' adds pins for other Windows architectures (issue #149). No verifiable ARM64 source exists yet: ftdichip.com blocks scripted downloads and the PyPI ft4222 package has no win_arm64 wheel, so ARM64 PCs use the x64 app and amd64 DLLs (Windows on ARM x64 emulation).
